verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜੋਧਾ ਜੁਧ ਸਮੇ ਸਸਤ੍ਰ ਸਨਾਹਿ ਸਾਜਿ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬੀਰ ਖੇਤ ਬਿਖੈ ਜਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jodhaa judh same sasatr sanaeh saaj lobh moh tiaag beer khet bikhai jaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a brave warrior goes to the battlefield wearing his armour and his weapons, renouncing all his love and attachments.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਤ ਜੁਝਾਊ ਘੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਗਤਿ ਬਿਗਸਾਤ  ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਭਟ ਘਟ ਅੰਗ ਨ ਸਮਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: sunat jujhaauoo ghor mor gat bigasaat  pekhat subhaT ghaT a(n)g na samaat hai ||

en.bdb: Listening to the inspiring music of battle songs he blooms like flower and feels happy and proud seeing the army spread like dark clouds in the sky.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਰਤ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਾਮ ਸ੍ਵਾਮ ਕਾਮ ਲਾਗਿ ਜੂਝ ਮਰੈ  ਕੈ ਤਉ ਰਣ ਜੀਤ ਬੀਤੀ ਕਹਤ ਜੁ ਗਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: karat sa(n)graam savaiaam kaam laag joojh marai  kai tau ran jeet beetee kahat ju gaat hai ||

en.bdb: Serving his master the king, he is performing his duties and is killed or else if alive, returns to narrate all the happenings of the battlefield.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਭਗਤ ਮਤ ਭੇਟਤ ਜਗਤ ਪਤਿ ਮੋਨਿ ਔ ਸਬਦ ਗਦ ਗਦ ਮੁਸਕਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੬੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: taise hee bhagat mat bheTat jagat pat mon aau sabadh gadh gadh musakaat hai ||617||

en.bdb: Similarly, a traveller of the path of devotion and worship becomes consciously one with the master of the world. He either becomes totally silent or singing His praises and paeans, remains in a state of ecstasy.  (617)
